protocol.selection: max mean inner AP corrected; tie 1e-6 min Brier then LR RF CatBoost XGBoost, then under_10 before under_5
protocol.primary: selection among undersampled real branches; all_real matched tuned control
protocol.threshold: max balanced accuracy inner OOF corrected; ties greater recall
protocol.strata: vascular group crossed with ages <60, 60..74, >=75; proportional survivor quotas with minimum one per nonempty stratum and largest remainder
protocol.undersampling: without replacement, all deaths retained; survivors min(available,ratio*deaths), ratios 10 and 5
protocol.preprocessing: fit imputation/scaling/encoder only on retained train
protocol.probabilities: r_s*p_raw/(1-p_raw+r_s*p_raw), r_s=train survivor inclusion rate by stratum; raw predictions retained; not guaranteed calibration
protocol.target_author_clarification: анкета contains expanded hospital outcomes; 55 death marks include overlap; not union with old endpoint
protocol.numeric_parser: Excel 1900 serial restored for date-like numerical cells; five audited repairs
